name: 2,000-Acre Land Recap
description: Land recapitalization case for a distressed ownership group, testing $4M of new equity, subordinated debt, IRR hurdles, and staged option payments to the landowner.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Existing capital stack and debt position review
  • New equity requirement and recap structure
  • Subordinated debt repayment sequencing
  • Landowner option payment schedule
  • IRR hurdle sensitivity by exit timing
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Land recapitalization model
  • Capital stack comparison
  • Option payment schedule
  • IRR hurdle and payoff waterfall
  • Recap strategy memo

name: 210-Unit Condo - 4 Scenarios
description: Comparative feasibility model for a 210-unit condo concept, evaluating market-rate, AMI-restricted, subsidy-supported, and TIF-backed financing scenarios against project IRR and funding gap requirements.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Market-rate and AMI-restricted revenue comparison
  • Subsidy and TIF financing assumptions
  • Affordability compliance impacts on project economics
  • Construction cost and funding gap sensitivity
  • Scenario ranking by feasibility and investor return
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Four-scenario feasibility model
  • AMI restriction comparison
  • TIF financing sensitivity
  • Funding gap summary
  • Recommendation matrix

name: LQ & Shift-Share Analysis
description: NAICS-based economic base study for a San Diego submarket, using location quotient and shift-share outputs to identify target industries and support planning memo recommendations.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Location quotient analysis by industry sector
  • Shift-share decomposition of employment growth
  • Regional benchmark comparison
  • Target industry identification
  • Planning implications for land use strategy
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Economic base analysis workbook
  • LQ and shift-share tables
  • Industry opportunity summary
  • Planning memo recommendations
  • Source documentation

name: Pacific Beach - Windshield Survey

  • Neighborhood resource and amenity mapping
  • Site constraint and access notes
  • Development opportunity identification
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Field survey notes
  • TOD context summary
  • Opportunity map
  • Parcel observation matrix
  • Planning recommendations

name: San Diego Site - Investor-Ready Concept
description: Investor-ready feasibility concept for an active San Diego site, combining design vision, planning constraints, program assumptions, proforma outputs, and presentation materials reviewed by industry judges.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Site constraints and entitlement pathway review
  • Program concept and massing assumptions
  • Design vision tied to market positioning
  • Development cost and revenue feasibility
  • Presentation narrative for investor review
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Feasibility analysis package
  • Concept design summary
  • Proforma and return outputs
  • Entitlement risk notes
  • Investor-ready presentation deck
